identificationModule.briefTitle: Kidney outcomes in adults with type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease (synthetic)

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 40 years or older
* Type 2 diabetes mellitus
* eGFR between 25 and 60 mL/min/1.73 m2
* Urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio of at least 200 mg/g

Exclusion Criteria:

* Kidney transplant
* Current dialysis
* Type 1 diabetes
